title: SpaceX Pad Abort Test News Conference
description: NASA’s Jon Cowart, partner manager for the agency’s Commercial Crew Program, and SpaceX’s Hans Koenigsmann, vice president of Mission Assurance, spoke to media during a pretest news conference on May 1, 2015 at Kennedy Space Center prior to the SpaceX pad abort test of the Crew Dragon spacecraft. SpaceX will perform the test under its Commercial Crew Integrated Capability (CCiCap) agreement with NASA, and will use the data gathered during the development flight as it continues on the path to certification.

via: the NASA Image and Video Library
